supply: Use case: stylized-concept. A single game sprite: small enchanted forest push-button on a wall cap. Strict orthographic 90-degree top down, flat face parallel to image, no side faces, no perspective. An irregular softly rounded square of dark carved oak, chunky twisted living roots framing its edges, patches of velvet moss and two small ivy leaves tucked into corners. Warm textured fantasy woodland craftsmanship matching a lush green forest arena and carved root-and-wood menus. Organic asymmetric silhouette, broad readable shapes, no metal, no screws, no machinery, no technological panels. One large simple central symbol in warm pale ivory carved wood with subtle relief; strong contrast on dark wood. Thin root edging does not crowd symbol. Isolated centered on genuinely transparent background, no floor or wall base, no surrounding scene or cast shadow, fills 88 percent of square canvas. Intended to remain clear at 28 pixels, restrained fine detail, soft natural overhead lighting, high quality painterly 2D game art, not pixel art. No text or watermark. Central symbol: a single bold cyan-blue lightning bolt (#35bfd3) in translucent enchanted sap inset, instead of ivory. Cyan is confined to the bolt.
